# 1 Samuel Chapter 20 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **Book:** 1 Samuel | **Chapter:** 20

---

### Verse 2
- **EMET:** "And-he-said to-him, "Far-be-it [chalilah]! You-shall-not die. Behold, my-father does-not do [a]-great thing or [a]-small thing without-uncovering my-e..."
- **LOGOS:** "And he said to him, "Far from it! You shall not die. Behold, my father does nothing great or small without disclosing it to me. And why should my fath..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Jonathan said, "That will never happen! My father does nothing, great or small, without telling me. Why would he hide this from me? It is not so.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 3
- **EMET:** "And-David-swore again and-said, "Your-father surely-knows that I-have-found favor in-your-eyes, and-he-said, 'Let-not Jonathan know this, lest he-be-g..."
- **LOGOS:** "But David swore again and said, "Your father surely knows that I have found favor in your eyes, and he thinks, 'Let not Jonathan know this, lest he be..."
- **PNEUMA:** "But David swore an oath and said, "Your father knows very well that I have found favor in your eyes, and he has said to himself, 'Jonathan must not kn..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 6
- **EMET:** "If your-father-misses me at-all, then-you-shall-say, 'David earnestly-asked of-me to-run to Beth-lehem his-city, for [the]-sacrifice of-the-days [is t..."
- **LOGOS:** "If your father misses me at all, then say, 'David earnestly asked leave of me to run to Bethlehem his city, for there is a yearly sacrifice there for ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "If your father misses me at all, say, 'David earnestly asked my permission to make a quick trip to Bethlehem, his hometown, because an annual sacrific..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 7
- **EMET:** "If thus he-says, 'Good' -- peace [shalom] to-your-servant. But-if it-is-hot [to]-anger to-him, know that the-evil is-determined from-with-him."
- **LOGOS:** "If he says, 'Good,' it will be well with your servant. But if he is angry, then know that evil is determined by him."
- **PNEUMA:** "If he says, 'Very well,' then your servant is safe. But if he loses his temper, you will know that he has determined to harm me."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 8
- **EMET:** "And-you-shall-do loyal-love [chesed] with your-servant, for into-a-covenant of-YHWH you-have-brought your-servant with-you. And-if there-is in-me iniq..."
- **LOGOS:** "Therefore deal loyally with your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the LORD with you. But if there is guilt in me, put me ..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Show this kindness to your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant with you before the LORD. If I am guilty, kill me yourself. Why ..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 9
- **EMET:** "And-Jonathan-said, "Far-be-it [chalilah] from-you! For if I-surely-knew that the-evil is-determined from-with my-father to-come upon-you, would-I-not ..."
- **LOGOS:** "And Jonathan said, "Far be it from you! If I knew that it was determined by my father that evil should come upon you, would I not tell you?""
- **PNEUMA:** "Jonathan said, "Never! If I had the slightest inkling that my father had determined to harm you, wouldn't I tell you?""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 14
- **EMET:** "And-not-only -- if I [am]-yet alive, and-you-shall-do with-me [the]-loyal-love [chesed] of-YHWH, and-I-shall-not die."
- **LOGOS:** "And if I am still alive, will you not show me the loyal love of the LORD, that I may not die?"
- **PNEUMA:** "And if I am still alive, show me the faithful love of the LORD. But if I die,"
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 15
- **EMET:** "And-you-shall-not cut-off your-loyal-love [chesed] from-with my-house forever [ʿad ʿolam], and-not when-YHWH cuts-off the-enemies of-David, each from-..."
- **LOGOS:** "And you shall not cut off your loyal love from my house forever, not even when the LORD cuts off every one of the enemies of David from the face of th..."
- **PNEUMA:** "never cut off your faithful love from my family — not even when the LORD has cut off every one of David's enemies from the face of the earth.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 17
- **EMET:** "And-Jonathan-continued to-swear to-David, because-of-his-love for-him, for with-[the]-love of-his-soul [nefesh] he-loved-him."
- **LOGOS:** "And Jonathan made David swear again by his love for him, for he loved him as he loved his own soul."
- **PNEUMA:** "And Jonathan had David reaffirm his oath out of his love for him, for Jonathan loved David as he loved his own life."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 25
- **EMET:** "And-the-king-sat upon his-seat as-time-by-time [kepha'am bepha'am], upon [the]-seat by-the-wall. And-Jonathan-arose, and-Abner-sat at-[the]-side of-Sa..."
- **LOGOS:** "The king sat on his seat, as at other times, on the seat by the wall. Jonathan rose, and Abner sat by Saul's side, but David's place was empty."
- **PNEUMA:** "The king sat in his usual place by the wall. Jonathan sat across from him, and Abner sat next to Saul. But David's place was empty."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 26
- **EMET:** "And-Saul did-not speak anything on-that day, for he-said, "[It is a]-chance [miqreh]; he [is] not clean, for he-has-not-been-cleansed.""
- **LOGOS:** "Yet Saul did not say anything that day, for he thought, "Something has happened to him. He is not clean; surely he is not clean.""
- **PNEUMA:** "Saul said nothing that day, for he thought, "Something has happened to him. He is unclean — surely he is unclean.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 38
- **EMET:** "And-Jonathan-called after the-lad, "Hurry, make-haste, do-not stand!" And-[the]-lad of-Jonathan gathered the-arrows and-came to his-master."
- **LOGOS:** "And Jonathan called after the boy, "Hurry! Be quick! Do not stay!" So Jonathan's boy gathered up the arrows and came to his master."
- **PNEUMA:** "Then Jonathan shouted to the boy, "Hurry! Be quick! Do not stop!" The boy picked up the arrow and returned to his master."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 39
- **EMET:** "And-the-lad did-not know anything; only Jonathan and-David knew the-matter."
- **LOGOS:** "But the boy knew nothing. Only Jonathan and David knew the arrangement."
- **PNEUMA:** "The boy knew nothing of all this. Only Jonathan and David understood the arrangement."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 40
- **EMET:** "And-Jonathan-gave his-weapons to the-lad that [was]-his, and-said to-him, "Go, bring [them] to-the-city.""
- **LOGOS:** "And Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and said to him, "Go and carry them to the city.""
- **PNEUMA:** "Then Jonathan gave his weapons to the boy and told him, "Go, take them back to town.""
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.
### Verse 42
- **EMET:** "And-Jonathan-said to-David, "Go in-peace [shalom], [in]-that which we-have-sworn, [the]-two of-us, in-[the]-name of-YHWH, saying, 'YHWH shall-be betwe..."
- **LOGOS:** "Then Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, because we have both sworn in the name of the LORD, saying, 'The LORD shall be between me and you, and betw..."
- **PNEUMA:** "Jonathan said to David, "Go in peace, for we have sworn friendship with each other in the name of the LORD, saying, 'The LORD is witness between me an..."
- **Resolution:** SOPHIA follows the LOGOS rendering as the formal-equivalence baseline, noting PNEUMA's dynamic phrasing as a valid alternative reading.

— SOPHIA
